ml.title: ഇതൊരു കളിയല്ല 🤯
ml.description:
റോക്ക്സ്റ്റാർ ഒടുവിൽ GTA 6 എക്സ്റ്റെൻഡഡ് ലുക്ക് ട്രെയിലർ പുറത്തിറക്കി, മാഷേ... ഇത് തീർച്ചയായും കാണേണ്ട ഒന്നാണ്! ഈ വീഡിയോയിൽ, പുതിയ ഗ്രാൻഡ് തെഫ്റ്റ് ഓട്ടോ 6 ട്രെയിലറിനോട് ഞാൻ തത്സമയം പ്രതികരിക്കുകയാണ് - വൈസ് സിറ്റി, ജേസൺ & ലൂസിയ, ഗ്രാഫിക്സ്, ഗെയിംപ്ലേ, എല്ലാം! നിങ്ങൾ എന്നെപ്പോലെ തന്നെ GTA 6-നെക്കുറിച്ച് ആവേശത്തിലാണെങ്കിൽ, ഈ വീഡിയോ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തരുത്!

Sahaa is a Rom Com Telugu movie directed by Nishanth Doti and starring Shiva Kumar Kasaram, Swetha Lakshman and music by Shekar Chandra. All Sahaa Telugu movie songs, lyrical videos, trailers and teasers are streaming on our channel.

🎬 Watch the trailer, share your thoughts and stay connected with Sumaira Studios for all the latest updates from SAHAA.

ప్రేమ, జ్ఞాపకాలు, అనుబంధాలు, జీవితంలో మనల్ని మార్చే కొన్ని ప్రత్యేకమైన క్షణాల కథే **‘సహా – లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ సంజు’**. సంజు జీవితంలో చోటుచేసుకున్న ప్రేమ, విడిపోవడం, గత జ్ఞాపకాలు అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేశాయనే ఆసక్తికరమైన కథాంశంతో ఈ చిత్రం తెరకెక్కుతోంది.

నిశాంత్ దోటి దర్శకత్వంలో రూపొందుతున్న ఈ సినిమాలో శివ కుమార్ కాసారం, శ్వేతా లక్ష్మణ్ ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో నటిస్తున్నారు. శేఖర్ చంద్ర సంగీతం అందిస్తున్నారు.

ప్రేమలోని అందమైన అనుభూతులతో పాటు, కోల్పోయిన బంధాల బాధను కూడా చూపించే ఈ చిత్రం ప్రేక్షకులకు ఒక భావోద్వేగ ప్రయాణాన్ని అందించబోతోంది.

**‘సహా – లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ సంజు’ సెప్టెంబర్ 4, 2026న థియేటర్లలో విడుదల కానుంది.** ❤️🎬

snippet.title: Operation Tral - Official Teaser Malayalam | Jayasurya | Ritika Singh |  Ratheesh Vega | Joby George
snippet.description:
Presenting the  Official Teaser of the Upcoming Malayalam Film Operation Tral
 Inspired by one of the most significant counter-terror operations in recent history, Operation Tral follows an intense investigation that unfolds in the aftermath of a devastating convoy attack in Kashmir.

Directed by Ratheesh Vega and starring Jayasurya in the lead, Operation Tral brings together a powerful ensemble cast and crew to tell a story of courage, sacrifice and the pursuit of justice.

Cast: Jayasurya, Rithika Singh, Murali Sharma, Vinay Rai, Vikram Kochhar, Kavya Shetty, Siddique, Saikumar, Anson Paul,Manju Pillai, Yash Gera, Hansika Bharat Jangid, Akshay Radhakrishnan, Sirajudheen Nazar, Neethu Krishna, Bashid Basheer, Joel Jo George


Movie Credits

Directed by: Ratheesh Vega
Produced by: Joby George Thadathil
Banner: Goodwill Entertainments

Cinematographer: Najose
Music and original score: Ratheesh Vega
Film Editor: Shafeeque V. B.
Production Designer: Sajeesh Thamarassery
Art Director: Suneesh Sodharan
Sound Mixing: M R Rajakrishnan
Sound Design: Vicky(Resonance audios)
Chief associate directors: Ullas Krishna, Kannan S Ulloor
Costume Design: Sameera Saneesh, Saritha Jayasurya
Makeup: Ronex Xavier
Project Designer: Noble Jacob
Production controller: Iqbal Panayikulam

Digital Marketing: Obscura Entertainments
PRO: Vazhoor Jose, Athira Diljith

Action Directors: Supreme Sundar and Kalai Kingson
Vfx: Digital turbo media
Vfx Supervisors: Lavan and Kusan
Colorist: Remesh C. P.
DI: Color planet studios
Teaser cuts: Bles Thomas
Publicity designs: Tenpoint
Other language dubbing director -RP Bala (RP studios)

snippet.title: இயேசையா உங்க சமூகம் | Yesaiah Unga Samugam | Joseph Aldrin | Tamil Christian New Song 2026
snippet.description:
This song was an answer to a question which I asked to myself in 2018 as I sat to worship .

Why do I long to worship and enjoy His presence. Why do I always want to come to Him and lean on His bosom by singing . 

And my heart answered it as a melody from Psalm 34:5 and Luke 10:38-42.

May God use this song and put a desire in many hearts to enjoy His bosom, & may He use this song to draw many to His intimate presence.


Written, Composed & Sung by JOSEPH ALDRIN
Music by JOHNPAUL REUBEN | Video by JUDAH ARUN 

Music Credits:
Music Produced & Arranged by Johnpaul Reuben @ Jes Productions
Rhythm Programming - Godwin
Flute - Aben Jotham  |  Veena - Shiva
Violin - Francis Xavier | Backing Vocals Harmony - Shobi Ashika 
Vocal Processing - Godwin 
Mix and Mastering - Jerome Alan Ebenezer @Joanna Studio
Flutes, Veena & Backing Vocals  Recorded @ Tapas Studios - Manoj
Vocals recorded @ Dreamscape Pro Studios - Samuel Graceson

Video Credits:
Camera & Drone: GIPSON SELLATHURAI, KEVIN FERNANDO 
Edit, Color Grading & Poster Design: JUDAH ARUN (+91- 97863 88181)

Special thanks to Pr. LARWIN NICKELSON, Oikos Tamil Church, Switzerland for all your hearty support and love.

Also grateful to Pr. JOHN KARUNA and Sis. LOUISAAL for all their love and support. Thank you WALTER uncle. My heartfelt thanks to GIPSON SELLATHURAI and KEVIN FERNANDO for all their labour of love as they shot the video tirelessly.

Thanks to Pr. JOSEPH BALACHANDRAN 


“I express my heartfelt gratitude
 to My Spiritual Father, Fr. S J BERCHMANS"



Lyrics 

இயேசைய்யா, உம் சமூகம் ஆர்வமாய் வருகிறேன் – 2

இதன் மகிழ்ச்சி, இதன் நிறைவு,
இதில் நீங்காத பேரின்பமே
இதன் மகிழ்ச்சி, இதன் நிறைவு,
இதில் நிரந்தர சமாதானமே

உம்மைப் பார்க்கப் பார்க்க பிரகாசம் அடைகின்றேன் – 2

வெட்கப்பட்டுப் போவதில்லை நான்,
வெட்கப்பட்டுப் போவதில்லை
வெட்கப்பட்டுப் போவதில்லை,
ஒருநாளும் வெட்கப்பட்டுப் போவதில்லை

தேவையானது ஒன்றே, எடுபடாதவரே
தேவையானது ஒன்றே, எடுபடாதவரே

நல்ல பங்கு நீர்தானையா எனக்கு,
நல்ல பங்கு நீர்தானையா – 2


For Contact:
https://www.josephaldrin.com/

ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ମଙ୍ଗଳ କରନ୍ତୁ ll       " ଜୟ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ "  🙏
ଚାରିଯୁଗରେ କିଏ କାହାକୁ ବାନ୍ଧିଲେ ରାକ୍ଷୀ - ଏହି ପବିତ୍ର ରାକ୍ଷୀ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିମା
ଅବସରରେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ ଏକ ଭାବପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଓ ମଧୁର ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭକ୍ତି ଭାବର ଗୀତ ll ସତ୍ୟ, ତ୍ରେତୟା, ଦ୍ଵାପର ଓ କଳି - ଏହି ଚାରି ଯୁଗରେ ଭାଇ-ଭଉଣୀଙ୍କ ସ୍ନେହ ଓ ସୁରକ୍ଷାର ପ୍ରତୀକ 'ରାକ୍ଷୀ'ର ପୌରାଣିକ ଗାଥାକୁ ନେଇ ରଚିତ ଏହି ସୁନ୍ଦର ଭଜନ।

snippet.title: 😱Shinchan vs Giant Chacha Clones & Granny's Secret Lair | Indian Theft Simulator
snippet.description:
😱Shinchan vs Giant Chacha Clones & Granny's Secret Lair | Indian Theft Simulator




In today's Indian Theft Simulator story, Shinchan finds himself in total chaos! A swarm of giant Chacha clones attacks Shinchan, chasing him all the way back to his house. To make matters worse, his house is packed with miniature Chacha clones, leaving him confused about who the real Chacha is. Out of frustration, Shinchan uses his AKM to clear out the clones, but the police arrive immediately and arrest him!
Luckily, Shinchan calls Jack from the police station, and Jack arrives just in time to bust him out. But the trouble doesn't end there—as soon as they return home, they discover that Granny, Kamala, and their gang have kidnapped Chacha, Nobita, and Priya! Watch how Shinchan and Jack gear up, invade Granny's secret hideout, defeat her entire squad, and bring everyone back safely.




#IndianTheftSimulator #Shinchan #ShinchanGaming #GamingStory #GrannyRescue #ShinchanAndJack #GamerCommunity #GamingSimulator

bn.title: 😱শিনচ্যান বনাম দানব কাকার ক্লোন এবং দাদির গোপন আস্তানা | ইন্ডিয়ান থেফট সিমুলেটর
bn.description:
😱শিনচান বনাম বিশাল চাচা ক্লোন ও গ্র্যানির গোপন আস্তানা | ইন্ডিয়ান থেফট সিমুলেটর

আজকের ইন্ডিয়ান থেফট সিমুলেটর গল্পে, শিনচান নিজেকে এক চরম বিশৃঙ্খলার মধ্যে খুঁজে পায়! বিশাল চাচা ক্লোনদের একটি ঝাঁক শিনচানকে আক্রমণ করে এবং তাকে তাড়া করে তার বাড়ি পর্যন্ত নিয়ে আসে। পরিস্থিতি আরও খারাপ হয় যখন তার বাড়িটি ছোট ছোট চাচা ক্লোনে ভর্তি থাকে, যার ফলে আসল চাচা কে, তা নিয়ে সে বিভ্রান্ত হয়ে পড়ে। হতাশ হয়ে শিনচান ক্লোনগুলোকে তাড়ানোর জন্য তার একেএম ব্যবহার করে, কিন্তু সাথে সাথেই পুলিশ এসে তাকে গ্রেপ্তার করে ফেলে!

ভাগ্যক্রমে, শিনচান পুলিশ স্টেশন থেকে জ্যাককে ফোন করে, এবং জ্যাক ঠিক সময়ে এসে তাকে ছাড়িয়ে আনে। কিন্তু সমস্যা এখানেই শেষ নয়—বাড়ি ফেরার সাথে সাথেই তারা আবিষ্কার করে যে গ্র্যানি, কমলা এবং তাদের দল চাচা, নোবিতা ও প্রিয়াকে অপহরণ করেছে! দেখুন কীভাবে শিনচান ও জ্যাক প্রস্তুত হয়ে গ্র্যানির গোপন আস্তানায় হানা দেয়, তার পুরো দলকে পরাজিত করে এবং সবাইকে নিরাপদে ফিরিয়ে আনে।

#ইন্ডিয়ানথেফটসিমুলেটর #শিনচান #শিনচানগেমিং #গেমিংস্টোরি #গ্র্যানিরেস্কিউ #শিনচানএন্ডজ্যাক #গেমারকমিউনিটি #গেমিংসিমুলেটর

मेरे कान्हा भैया, मेरी राखी स्वीकार करो 🙏💖
रक्षाबंधन के पावन पर्व पर समर्पित यह मधुर कृष्ण भक्ति गीत भाई-बहन के प्रेम, विश्वास और भक्ति की सुंदर भावना को समर्पित है। इस भजन में एक बहन अपने प्रिय कान्हा को भैया मानकर प्रेम से राखी बाँधती है और उनसे सुख-दुख में साथ निभाने की प्रार्थना करती है। 🦚💖
